The '''Declorian Territory''' was a region of space in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians]] terrorized the Declorian Territory with a fierce fist. Often times, unless business was mentioned, the Spice Guardians were not open to having visitors.

In addition to the Spice Guardians, the Declorian Territory was home to [[Blacklight Pirates]], and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]].
